data.title: Islamic University Recommends Leveraging the Kingdom's Efforts in Developing AI Technologies
data.content:
Madinah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Islamic University of Madinah, represented by its College of Shariah, recommended leveraging the Kingdom's efforts in developing artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and applying Islamic jurisprudential principles and the objectives of Shariah to the study of contemporary AI applications and the establishment of their Shariah rulings.
    The recommendation came during the Third Student Forum, titled "Artificial Intelligence: Contemporary Issues and Shariah Rulings," held during the Second Graduate Studies Week.
    The forum's key recommendations included examining AI's impact on the judiciary, arbitration, and dispute resolution; promoting Shariah studies that keep pace with technological developments, thereby contributing to the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030; and preparing a guide outlining Shariah controls and ethical guidelines for the use of these technologies to safeguard academic integrity, rights, and privacy.
    The recommendations also called for transforming outstanding student research into scientific projects and practical guides, organizing a specialized scientific conference to examine AI developments and establish Shariah rulings, and promoting the use of AI in issuing fatwas and delivering Shariah education.
    -- SPA
